instructions: Start each objective with relai_work action begin and pass its work_id to later calls. Inspect relevant files before editing; use bounded reads and commands. Validate after changes. Never bypass approval, workspace, task, or destructive-operation safeguards. Report only checks actually run. Finish with relai_validate action checks complete:true, or relai_work action finish after review.

tools.name: relai_changes
tools.title: Review or Restore Changes

tools.description: The one tool for changing files. Use oldText/newText with optional occurrence, replacements:[...] for several exact edits in one file, content for full-file replacement, updateText for patch-shaped changes, or edits:[...] for an atomic batch of up to 100 files. Keep larger repository-wide changes together as one logical updateText patch; if one request is too large, send staged updateText chunks and commit once instead of splitting the migration into repeated edit batches. Large content stages automatically. expectedSha256 is supported for direct, staged, and batch file edits.

inputSchema.description: Choose one primary form. Rel.AI validates the selected form before touching the workspace.

content.description: Complete replacement content for one file. Use with path; an empty string creates an empty file.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview the edit without changing files.

edits.description: Atomic structured batch of up to 100 file edits.

envAction.description: Secret-safe environment operation: list, set, remove, or compare.

expectedSha256.description: Optional stale-write guard for direct, staged, batch, and environment edits.

key.description: Environment key used by envAction set or remove.

level.description: Validation level used when runChecks is true.

newText.description: Replacement text paired with oldText. An empty string deletes the matched text.

occurrence.description: One-based occurrence to replace when oldText is not unique.

oldText.description: Exact non-empty current text to replace. Pair with newText.

path.description: Workspace-relative target path. Required for full-file content and exact replacement forms.

replacements.description: Several exact oldText/newText replacements in one file.

returnDiff.description: Return a bounded diff after a successful edit.

runChecks.description: Run detected validation checks after a successful edit.

stage.description: Chunked content or updateText lifecycle: start, append, commit, or abort.

templatePath.description: Public environment template used by envAction compare.

updateText.description: Git unified diff or structured OpenAI patch text for patch-shaped changes.

value.description: Environment value used by envAction set. Values are never returned.

work_id.description: Opaque ID returned when a repository work session begins.

workspace.description: Optional workspace ownership assertion. The work_id already identifies the bound workspace.

writeId.description: Opaque staged-write ID returned by stage start.

tools.name: relai_edit
tools.title: Edit Repository

tools.description: Run a one-shot workspace command. Prefer executable + argv (+ optional input) whenever shell features are not required. Use command only when the operation intentionally needs shell syntax such as pipes, redirection, environment expansion, or shell built-ins. Direct mode avoids PowerShell/cmd/bash reparsing and preserves quotes, backticks, dollar signs, JSON, and multiline script text exactly.

inputSchema.description: Choose exactly one execution mode. Prefer direct executable + argv mode by default; choose command only when shell parsing is deliberately needed.

work_id.description: Opaque ID returned when a repository work session begins.
Opaque ID returned when a repository work session begins.

argv.description: Literal argument array passed directly to executable without shell parsing. Keep each logical argument as its own item.

command.description: Shell command string. Use only when shell syntax is intentionally required. Do not embed JavaScript, Python, JSON, patches, or other quote-sensitive multiline scripts here when direct mode can run them.

env.description: Optional environment variables supplied directly to the child process.

executable.description: Executable to launch directly with shell:false, for example node, python, git, or an absolute executable path. Preferred for scripts and structured arguments.

input.description: Optional literal UTF-8 stdin for direct mode. Prefer this for multiline scripts or structured text so quotes, backticks, dollar signs, and newlines are preserved exactly.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum captured stdout/stderr bytes before output is truncated.
